text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Herpes Simplex Virus (HSV) infection. The combination of a maculopapular rash with pustules on an erythematous base, sparing the palms and soles, along with tachycardia and tachypnea, is highly suggestive of disseminated HSV. I am requesting a PCR test for HSV DNA from blood and skin lesions to confirm this.
